subject: Greenfield Health — inbound-to-CS transition and kickoff plan
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Chen <emma@greenfieldhealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Greenfield Health — summary + next steps before kickoff

Team —

Quick summary of where the deal landed after legal and procurement: Greenfield signed the managed Dedicated plan with a 12-month term (start: 2027-11-01). Main customer asks we should track during onboarding: SSO (SAML), data retention settings for logs/metrics, SOC2 evidence for model serving, and a short pilot of 3 production routes.

Attached: greenfield_sow_v2.pdf (SOW with milestones), redwood-security-brief.pdf (summary of controls). I also included a simple roles matrix (transition-roles-sheet.xlsx).

Immediate asks for CS/Implementation:
- Can CS own kickoff scheduling? Customer is targeting 11/6 for the technical kickoff and 11/20 to start pilot traffic.
- Primary success metric: 99th pct latency under 350ms for 512-token baseline in staging.
- Risk: procurement asked for an SLA exception on data retention for 30 days — legal approved but flagged for monitoring.

Marissa: assigning you as primary CSM. Karthik: please own the implementation PM lane and confirm resource availability.

I will remain as the escalation owner until 11/30.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: greenfield_sow_v2.pdf (pdf), redwood-security-brief.pdf (pdf), transition-roles-sheet.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Chen <emma@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenfield Health — summary + next steps before kickoff

Thanks Marcus —

Appreciate the concise summary. Quick notes from the CS side:
- I can take the kickoff scheduling. I have availability windows 11/4–11/8 (mornings PT) for a 60–90m technical kickoff. Will propose 11/6 10am PT to the customer.
- For SSO, we will need the customer IdP metadata and a test user ahead of the kickoff (preferably 48–72h early).
- For the latency target, I'll add a pre-kickoff perf checklist to confirm baseline dataset and traffic shape.

Open questions for Marcus:
- Can you confirm who will be our day-2 contact at Greenfield (product/infra) beyond Emma/Tom?
- Any outstanding contractual attachments that affect onboarding scope (e.g., custom retention settings beyond the 30-day note)?

I'll draft a kickoff agenda and share the calendar invite once Marcus confirms the 11/6 ask.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Marissa —

Confirmed: 11/6 10am PT for technical kickoff is ok from my side. Emma/Tom please confirm.

Answers to your questions:
- Day-2 contact: Emma confirmed engineering lead will be Rafael Soto (rafael.soto@greenfieldhealth.com) for infra and integration. I copied him on the SOW but not on this thread yet; Rafael expects to join the kickoff.
- Contractual: the SOW attachment is the signed version; the only special retention item is the 30-day log retention exception (Legal approved) — no other custom terms.

I've uploaded a short pre-kickoff checklist to the shared Drive link (see related_links). I'll push an invite once Emma confirms the time.

Subject: Re: Greenfield Health — summary + next steps before kickoff

Hi Marcus / Marissa —

11/6 10am PT works for us. Rafael will join for the infra portion. A few items for the agenda please:
- SAML metadata exchange and who will configure the IdP side (we use Okta).
- Confirm data retention policies and whether logs stored in customer-owned buckets are accepted. Our security team will want the SOC2 summary and an owner to follow up on evidence requests.
- Pilot routes: we will start with the two higher-throughput routes first and add a third after the first week.

We reviewed the SOW and are good to proceed. Legal might send a minor redline to the retention paragraph; forwarding to legal now.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.
Emma
Emma Chen
Director, Platform Integrations — Greenfield Health
emma@greenfieldhealth.com

Subject: Internal: resource assignment and pre-kickoff risks (internal note)

Marissa/Marcus —

Internal staffing note: I can assign Priya N. as lead implementation PM (Priya available 11/1–11/30) and earmark one infra engineer (on-call) for the first two weeks of the pilot. Will confirm names by 10/6.

Risks to flag for the kickoff:
- Legal redline on retention may push minor scope changes — if legal asks to move logs to a customer-owned bucket, that will add ~2 days to the infra prep.
- SAML metadata from Greenfield must be provided at least 72h before kickoff to avoid delays.
- We should confirm bandwidth for load-generation during pilot to validate latency SLOs.

I'll prepare a short implementation runbook and share before the kickoff.

- Karthik

Emma / team —

Thanks for the fast confirmation. I've created the kickoff calendar invite for 11/6 10am PT (invite attached) and shared the pre-kickoff checklist in Drive. Quick operational checklist (short):
- Emma / Rafael: please share SAML metadata + a test Okta user by 11/3 EOD.
- Legal: please send any retention redline before 11/4 so we can assess impact.
- Greenfield: confirm which two routes will be part of week-0 pilot (route names or IDs).

CS/Impl plan:
- Primary CSM: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai)
- Implementation PM: Priya Natarajan (assignment pending confirmation; Karthik will finalize)
- Infra lead: Rafael (Greenfield) + Redwood infra engineer (TBD)

I will run the kickoff and share meeting notes + action items within 24h after the call. If anything changes, please reply-all and I will escalate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
